notes.title: Game Lens Update v0.70
notes.notes:
[b]Game Lens – Release Notes (v0.70) [/b]

[quote][b]Update v0.70[/b]
New features, fixes, and smoother UI animations.
The app is still [b]25% OFF[/b] for [b]two weeks[/b] after release: [b]Sep 2 → Sep 16[/b].
Report issues and share feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/bFCtMKUADc]Discord[/url].[/quote]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842680/Game_Lens

[h2]✨ Highlights[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Follow Cursor (new)[/b] 
[b]Toggle[/b] (default: [i]Numpad 1[/i]) and [b]Push/Hold[/b] (default: [i]Numpad 0[/i]) modes
Optional [b]double-click[/b] activation window (shared for both modes)
Restores your previous window/capture position when turned off

[*] [b]Less cursor flicker[/b] – Reduced cursor jitter while the lens is visible.
[/list]


[h2]🛡 Safe Mode (Anti‑cheat) compatibility[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Auto‑disabled with clear UI[/b] – In Safe Mode, the following features turn OFF, gray out, and their switches animate to the OFF position:
[*] [b]Follow Cursor[/b], [b]Quick Setup[/b], [b]Smooth show/hide[/b], [b]Show Crosshair[/b], [b]Show Zoom Hint[/b], [b]Color[/b], [b]Sensitivity[/b], [b]Click‑through[/b], [b]Window Opacity[/b]
[*] Active gestures/follow mode are stopped immediately for clarity.
[/list]

[h2]🎨 UI/UX [/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Hotkey inputs restyled[/b] – Violet bordered inputs for better visibility:
Applies to main hotkeys, [b]Follow Cursor[/b] hotkeys, and [b]Zoom Presets[/b].
[/list]

[h2]🛠 Bug fixes & improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed opacity/fade conflicts; animations no longer interfere with opacity changes.
[*] Restored 50% transparency while dragging in Quick Setup, even with fade enabled.
[*] Fixed common toggle visual desync (switch stuck ON position with OFF colors).
[*] Improved per‑monitor DPI handling for Follow Cursor to eliminate corner drift.
[/list]


[b]Sale:[/b] 25% OFF from [b]Sep 2[/b] to [b]Sep 16[/b]
[b]Release date:[/b] 07 Sep 2025
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.70

notes.title: Game Lens Release
notes.notes:
[b]🎉 Game Lens – Release Notes (v0.69) 🎉[/b]

[quote][b]It’s release time![/b]  
Game Lens officially launches on Steam today!  
To celebrate, the app is [b]25% OFF[/b] for the next [b]two weeks[/b]. Don’t miss it!  
Please report any issues in our [url=https://discord.gg/bFCtMKUADc]Discord[/url].[/quote]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842680/Game_Lens/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/a43e6945dfc5bc67f537851972e7d6bdf8096666.gif[/img]
[h2]✨ Highlights[/h2]
[list]

[b]Double-click hotkey[/b] – New [b]Push/Toggle via double-tap[/b]! Show the lens by pressing a hotkey twice quickly (default: [b]300 ms[/b], customizable).
[b]Steam Cloud sync[/b] – Config files now automatically synchronize between your PCs via [b]Steam Cloud[/b].
[b]Localized store screenshots[/b] – The Steam store page now displays language-specific screenshots for each supported locale.

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/ef377817fcea143f4f2f00fbdb8835661d4c9be2.png[/img]
[h2]➤ Security/Compliance Notes[/h2]
[list]
No drivers, no admin rights, no low-level hooks.  
All user data remains in [tt]%APPDATA%\Game Lens[/tt].  

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/e6e23e6f4d288a9ce5115e499c0af1b5597980c5.png[/img]
[i]Thanks for supporting the journey to 1.0 release!  
Click the [b]Discord[/b] button in-app and share your feedback – it helps us improve Game Lens even faster.[/i]

[b]Release date:[/b] 2025-09-02
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.69
